label: copy phase: input c or j while outputting j (recall position >= 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the input token is c (86% of mass) or j (14%). Its strongest firing is when the input is c and the next token to output is j, i.e. the model is reproducing an original c-j bigram. Top examples (about 0.8-1.0 of max) are all c->j at recall positions 2-4, often with j j following. Restricting to input c, output j, recall_idx >= 3 gives about 96% precision but only 42% recall. Activations on the second step (input j, output j, as in c j j) are weaker (about 0.15-0.45 of max). Weak low-quartile activations occur on input c with other outputs (c->e, c->0, c->k, ...), and these account for most of the missed activations. It does not fire on recall positions 0-1 and rarely at recall position 2, never in the original or delimiter phases, and never on input tokens other than c and j. Many c/j->j steps at early recall positions are false positives.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
